_about: Tabletop mode: every character's numbers in whole counters (max 20 each of HP, mana and ward). Names, colours and forbidden elements come from characters.json unless set here. Each spell's 'text' is its card text: keep it in step with the numbers. Rules: docs/tabletop-rules.md. Engine and simulator: js/tabletop.js.

spells.name: Shield
spells.text: Arcane ward of 14 (a Greater ward is 12).

spells.name: Counter
spells.text: 3 rounds: anyone who strikes you takes 2, and your ward doesn't wear down.

spells.name: Ward
spells.text: 3 rounds: curses can't touch you. The next dispel only removes this Ward.

spells.name: Empower
spells.text: Your next strike deals double damage.

spells.name: Blood Pact
spells.text: Turn 3 HP winks into mana winks before you flick, and pot with them. If it is cast, gain 4 more mana.

spells.name: Drain
spells.text: Dark strike of 4. Heal half the HP damage it deals (round down).

spells.name: Regen
spells.text: Heal 1 at the end of each round for 5 rounds.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.text: Roll a die: on 4+ the foe can't pick Damage next round.

spells.name: Vine Whip
spells.text: Physical strike of 3, then vines deal 1 at the end of each round for 3 rounds.

spells.name: Foresight
spells.text: The next strike at you within 3 rounds does nothing.

spells.name: Time Drain
spells.text: 3 rounds: the foe gains 2 less mana each round (and from Meditate).

spells.name: Rewind
spells.text: Arcane ward of 7, and heal the HP you lost last round (max 5).

spells.name: War Paint
spells.text: 3 rounds: every hit on you deals 1 less (min 1).

spells.name: Savage Charge
spells.text: Physical strike of 5. The foe loses 2 mana.

spells.name: Frenzy
spells.text: 2 rounds: your strikes deal +2, but each costs you 1 HP.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.text: Fire strike of 4 (a Lesser strike is 2).

spells.name: Flame Shield
spells.text: Fire ward of 8. While it holds, anyone who strikes you takes 2.

spells.name: Candle
spells.text: 3 rounds: the foe takes 2 each time they cast Protection or Meditate.

spells.name: Ice Lance
spells.text: Ice strike of 5. If it reaches HP, the foe can't pick Damage next round.

spells.name: Frost Armor
spells.text: 3 rounds: every hit on you deals 1 less (min 1), and strikers take 1.

spells.name: Blizzard
spells.text: 4 rounds: at the end of each round the foe takes 1 and loses 1 mana.

spells.name: Galvanize
spells.text: Your next Lightning strike deals +3.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.text: Lightning strike of 4. Roll a die: on 4+ it arcs for 2 more.

spells.name: Conductivity
spells.text: 4 rounds: every strike on the foe deals +1.

spells.name: Heal
spells.text: Heal 6.

spells.name: Purge
spells.text: Remove all your curses and heal 3.

spells.name: Radiant
spells.text: Arcane strike of 3. The foe loses 2 mana.

spells.name: Agony
spells.text: 3 rounds: the foe takes 2 at the end of each round, unless they Meditated that round (while Corrupted, Meditate doesn't escape it).

spells.name: Silence
spells.text: 3 rounds: each spell the foe casts, they roll a die: on 1–3 it fails (no mana spent).

spells.name: Corruption
spells.text: 3 rounds: the foe gains 3 less mana each round (and from Meditate), and Meditate doesn't escape Agony.

spells.name: Vanish
spells.text: The next strike at you within 3 rounds misses.

spells.name: Mana Siphon
spells.text: Quick: before anyone pays, steal 4 mana from the foe.

spells.name: Blink
spells.text: 3 rounds: roll a die for each strike at you, on 4+ it misses. Plus a Lightning ward of 3.

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.text: Physical ward of 9.

spells.name: Stonesoul
spells.text: 3 rounds: every hit on you deals 1 less (min 1).

spells.name: Rockfall
spells.text: Physical strike of 7.

spells.name: Conjure Blade
spells.text: Conjure a blade (max 3). Each blade deals 1 to the foe at the end of every round.

spells.name: Bladestorm
spells.text: Needs a blade. Launch all your blades: a Physical strike of 3 per blade. The blades are used up.

spells.name: Iron Patience
spells.text: 3 rounds: every hit on you deals 1 less (min 1).

spells.name: Plague
spells.text: 4 rounds: the foe takes 1 at the end of each round.

spells.name: Maggot Cloud
spells.text: The foe loses 2 mana now, and gains 3 less each round (and from Meditate) for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Bone Totem
spells.text: Heal 1 at the end of each round for 4 rounds.

spells.name: Raise Dead
spells.text: Raise a skeleton (max 2) for 3 rounds. Each deals 1 to the foe at the end of every round. If one is dispelled, heal 2.

spells.name: Necrotic Drain
spells.text: Dark strike of 4. Heal half the HP damage it deals (round down).

spells.name: Reinforce
spells.text: Physical ward of 5, +3 for each skeleton you have.

spells.name: Simulacrum
spells.text: Summon a simulacrum (max 2) for 3 rounds. Each deals 1 to the foe at the end of every round.

spells.name: Bewitch
spells.text: The foe's next strike within 2 rounds hits themselves instead.

spells.name: Feint
spells.text: Arcane strike of 4. The foe loses 2 mana.

spells.name: Enthral
spells.text: Secretly write down Damage, Protection or Dispel. If the foe's next pick is that, it's lost and you take up to 3 of the mana they paid.

spells.name: Arcane Weave
spells.text: Your next 3 strikes deal +1 and make the foe lose 2 mana. Plus an Arcane ward of 3.

spells.name: Spellbind
spells.text: 4 rounds: the foe's most-cast category (Damage, Protection or Dispel) costs 3 more.

spells.name: Dragon Scales
spells.text: 3 rounds: every hit on you deals 1 less (min 1), and strikers take 1.

spells.name: Wyrmfire Breath
spells.text: Fire strike of 4, then the foe burns for 1 at the end of each round for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Ancient Wrath
spells.text: Physical strike of 9. Once per game.

spells.name: Caustic Bomb
spells.text: Dark strike of 3, then poison deals 1 at the end of each round for 3 rounds. If the strike reached HP, the poison ignores wards.

spells.name: Volatile Tonic
spells.text: Roll a die: on 1–3 heal 5; on 4–6 your next strike deals +2.

spells.name: Unstable Concoction
spells.text: Arcane strike: roll a die and deal that much. On a 6, roll again and add it (keep going on 6s).

spells.name: Singularity
spells.text: A rift: the foe takes 1, then 2, then 3 at the end of the next 3 rounds.

spells.name: Gravity Well
spells.text: Dark strike of a third of the foe's HP (round down, min 3).

spells.name: Event Horizon
spells.text: Arcane strike of half the foe's HP (round down, min 4). You take 2.
